title: Self-inner product of a sign function
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a $\pm 1$-valued Boolean function, so that $f(x) \in \{-1, 1\}$ for every $x \in \{0,1\}^n$. Then its $L^2$ inner product with itself, taken with respect to the uniform measure on the cube, equals $1$:
\[
  \langle f, f \rangle \;=\; 2^{-n}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} f(x)^2 \;=\; 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
